title: Carrier in an n-plane: the orientation is ±τ₁∧⋯∧τₙ almost everywhere
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (R : IMRep U n with M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult, ξ = R.orient). Let τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P and Q := span{τ_1, …, τ_n}. If H^n(M ∖ Q) = 0 (H^n = μHE[n]), then for H^n-a.e. x ∈ M (that is, μHE[n].restrict M-a.e.) either ξ(x)(α) = α(τ_1, …, τ_n) for every n-covector α (α ∈ Covector (Euclid P) n), or ξ(x)(α) = −α(τ_1, …, τ_n) for every n-covector α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))) = 0 → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x α = α τ) ∨ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, R.orient x α = -α τ)
